x: Although he had little opposition to trouble him Carl Lawton's 58.40 compares well with other winners of this trophy. In the accompanying match Bob Barnes returned a powerful 54.35 to finish 1 minute behind Bill Sutherland of the Police.
Len Duquemin confirmed his recent speedy form with a fine second place just 7 seconds down on Bill Sutherland. Although he finished in the first 8 John Moullin was not good enough to make the team !

His greatest rivals for places in the Scottish team will be Bill Sutherland (Highgate H.) and Alan Buchanan (Brighton & Hove A.C.). In 1967 Len Duquemin won the Southern 'Garnet' 10 Miles Championship and lead Sarnia Walking Club from Guernsey to success in the team championship.
Unfortunately this race coincided with Wilf Wesch's accounts so we were denied what might have been a fantastic race between John Knifton, Wilf and Bill Sutherland.
Carl Lawton once again excelled with a personal best which put him among the really fast boys and ahead of Commonwealth Bronze Medallist Bill Sutherland.

Phil Embleton won this years race although he had a battle with Bill Sutherland for much of the distance. Carl Lawton started well down the field but gradually moved through to almost 2nd place but Sutherland's sprint finish was more than he could manage.
Next on the track with Bels now in a one point lead were the 10,000m boys. A comfortable win by Amos Seddon over Bill Sutherland left Ray Middleton to come in fourth and Len Duquemin 5th.
